GenAiPromptTemplate.description: This is used to generate details about product installation of given product

templateVersions.content:
As a technical expert, analyze the following product details and provide a clear, step-by-step installation guide:
Product Name: {!$Input:SelectedProduct.Name} Product Description: {!$Input:SelectedProduct.Description} all other details about the product : {!$RecordSnapshot:SelectedProduct.Snapshot}
Please provide: 1. Required tools and materials 2. Safety precautions 3. Detailed installation steps 4. Tips for optimal installation 5. Common mistakes to avoid 6. Post-installation checks
don't give any extra details only focus on installation
